summary.text: Teri Ann Hourihan, a therapist, is the No Labels Party nominee for governor with running mate Angela Harrolle Mohan, a real estate broker. She won the No Labels primary 56% to 44% over Hugh Lytle.

paragraphs.text: Therapist; named Angela Harrolle Mohan, a real estate broker, as her running mate on August 6, 2026.
